home.label: Defend the Paraná
home.blurb: Seven missions at Itaipu, three stars each, opened one at a time. Credits buy warheads and more.

home.label: The Interior
home.blurb: Survey a quiet region from the air. Notice, follow, record. Unknown means unknown.

home.label: Defence training
home.blurb: Three lessons in the war's own rooms: an interception, a track held, then a mission flown with others.

home.label: Field hangar
